dedupe_keys.name: iride earth observation constellation data and marketplace italian space agency

description: IRIDE is the largest Italian Earth observation programme, a constellation of satellite constellations with ground infrastructure and geospatial services built with the European Space Agency and funded under the National Recovery and Resilience Plan (PNRR). The Italian Space Agency announced on 1 July 2026 that IRIDE had entered its operational phase and that it was progressively opening access to the first satellite data and geospatial services through the IRIDE Marketplace, where users can consult the catalogue of available data, request new satellite acquisitions and use operational products and services as the system grows. The first images are gathered in a gallery on the Marketplace, and the announcement names civil protection, environmental monitoring, security, cultural heritage and international cooperation among the uses. In the first phase the system serves Italian institutional users, who can access the data and products free of charge under the IRIDE data policy; access for international users and companies is planned later. No licence is named in the announcement read. Caveats: service entry is gradual as the constellations are completed, and access is at first limited to public bodies. Coverage is Italy. It supports hazard exposure and emergency response analysis, such as flood, landslide and ground motion monitoring around infrastructure; related records are the Italian Civil Protection maps and dashboards and CONAE's geoportal.
